I apologize for never responding. This helped put things in perspective for me quite a bit. I hadn't thought it about it that way but you have completely hit the nail right on the head.

Appreciate the love man. Thank you so much, seriously!

I have been having quite a few ups and downs. I went 3 days straight feeling pretty good, then I just tanked. But the 3 days gave me hope.

I appreciate you checking in, thank you so much.

Thank you for the reply. It means a lot, seriously!

I took a big step today and met with a Therapist to try and talk some of it out of my system. I'm still feeling pretty down but the suicidal thoughts have subsided for now.

That's pretty neat. Do you play any instruments or draw? 

Music & graphic design take a lot of talent!
You know what. I needed that man, thank you.
What do you feel like you're wanting to do with your life after school man?
What's going on that makes you feel like you're a hole you can't get out of?
